description: IncarnaMind is a free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux where you ask questions about your own documents (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and more) and write with AI. Every answer cites the exact page, and IncarnaMind checks that each quoted passage is really there.
summary: The AI notebook that checks its own citations. Ask your PDFs, Word files, slides and spreadsheets; answers cite the exact page. Open-source desktop app.
